from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from delta.tables import DeltaTable

silver_path = "abfss://synapse-filename@synapase.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/customer"
gold_path = "abfss://synapse-filename@synapase.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/customer_scd2"

silver_df = spark.read.format("delta").load(silver_path)

silver_df.show(truncate=False)

"""implement scd2 first timein silver layer"""
gold_df = (
    silver_df
    .withColumn("start_date", F.to_date("updated_at"))
    .withColumn("end_date", F.lit(None).cast("date"))
    .withColumn("is_current", F.lit(True))
)

gold_df.write \
    .format("delta") \
    .mode("overwrite") \
    .save(gold_path)

gold_table = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, gold_path)

gold_table.alias("tgt").merge(
    silver_df.alias("src"),
    "tgt.customer_id = src.customer_id AND tgt.is_current = true"
).whenMatchedUpdate(
    condition="""
        NOT (tgt.customer_name <=> src.customer_name)
        OR NOT (tgt.city <=> src.city)
        OR NOT (tgt.state <=> src.state)
    """,
    set={
        "end_date": "current_date()",
        "is_current": "false"
    }
).execute()

gold_table = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, gold_path)

gold_table.alias("tgt").merge(
    silver_df.alias("src"),
    "tgt.customer_id = src.customer_id AND tgt.is_current = true"
).whenNotMatchedInsert(
    values={
        "customer_id": "src.customer_id",
        "customer_name": "src.customer_name",
        "city": "src.city",
        "state": "src.state",
        "created_at": "src.created_at",
        "updated_at": "src.updated_at",
        "start_date": "current_date()",
        "end_date": "CAST(NULL AS DATE)",
        "is_current": "true"
    }
).execute()

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

silver_df = spark.read.format("delta").load(silver_path)

test_df = silver_df.withColumn(
    "city",
    F.when(
        F.col("customer_id") == "C001",
        F.lit("Pune")
    ).otherwise(F.col("city"))
).withColumn(
    "updated_at",
    F.when(
        F.col("customer_id") == "C001",
        F.lit("2026-10-28T10:00:00")
    ).otherwise(F.col("updated_at"))
)

test_df.write \
    .format("delta") \
    .mode("overwrite") \
    .save(silver_path)
